notes.title: BUILDING UPDATE NOW LIVE 0.13.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

A new update has just gone live which includes a major addition. Players will be able to construct their own buildings by crafting a selection of items. We have decided to share the crafting recipes with you, but first we have a brand new video which will share some of the constructs you can make in the system

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NYfKBNWDSYo

[h1]Crafting recipes[/h1]
Wooden Plank = Wood Stick + Wood Stick + String + Tie
Wooden Post = Wood Stick + String + Wood Stick + Tie
Wall = Post + Post + Post + Tie
Slope = Plank + Post + Wood Stick + Tie
Window = Plank + Plank + Cut + Tie
Door = Post + Post + Plank + Tie
Floor = Plank + Plank + Plank + Tie
Pillar = Post + Post + Tie
Fence = Wood Stick + Post + Tie

To help with the large amount of wood that players will need to find to construct these buildings, we have added a new item, an axe! The axe will be found on the island and can be used to chop down a new type of tree which will have significant amount of wood sticks. You can still gather wood sticks from shaking trees but chopping down these dead trees will give you a greater amount of wood.

Additionally, players will begin each game wearing a random clothing item. Sometimes they may be wearing jeans, other times they may be shirtless. 
We hope you enjoy building and please share your construction in the steam forums!

notes.title: Update 0.12.0
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,
A big thank you for all those who continue to show support for Better Late Than DEAD. 
We an update which adds a new feature to the game and some new items.

[h1]0.12.0[/h1]
[list][*]New craftable item - Cotton Line (Name subject to change)
[*]New craftable item - Small Trap
[*]New trap system in place
[*]Use items directly from inventory
[*]Keys can now be rebound
[*]Key binds saved in editable text file
[*]Names of items appear when hovering the mouse over
[/list]
[h1]Trap System[/h1]

You can now place traps around certain parts of the island (Mainly inland away from beaches.) Once you have placed the trap, you will need to leave the area so you don’t spook small animals. After a certain period of time an unsuspecting creature may wonder into your trap.

[h1]New Key Binding System[/h1]

You can now change your key bindings to suit your needs. You can do this both in the main menu and in the pause menu of the game.
Currently there are issues with the key binding while in the main menu; however it is working as intended when bringing up the options while in game.

Thanks again for all the support over the last couple of months.

notes.title: Update 0.11.12
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thank you all for your continued support through the early access of Better Late Than DEAD. We are continuing to gather your suggestions and improve the game.
Our latest update is now live and includes the following

[h1]0.11.12[/h1]
-Dutch and German languages fixed
-More collison model fixes
-Most invisible walls now removed
-Freezing has been rebalanced
-Changes made to help text
-New seashell knife item (used only as a weapon for now)
-New sleep system

This new update brings in the hugely requested sleep system, you can now sleep in any bed currently in the game for upto 12 hours. However be aware that even when sleeping your thirst and hunger will decrease so make sure you are well fed before bed.

notes.title: Update 0.11.11
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Firstly I would like to thank everyone for their continued support of our product. We would also like to apologise for the delay in this update. We have been away at gamescom and are now back to updating BLTD full time. But to make up for the last two weeks, we have a very long update list for you.

[h1]0.11.11[/h1]

- Added Help guide to main menu
- Added control guide to pause menu
- Added a notebook to the Stats area so you can read past notes
- Added new item, Edible coconut. 
  This can be crafted by cutting the coconut again after you have finished drinking from it.
- Retexturing of buildings to improve overall performance
- Changes made to the rain to further improve performance
- menu button fixes
- Old key has beter visuals so it can be seen better
- Removed many of the invisible walls which can be found on the island
- Drinking animation fixed
- Many of the ground clutter decals have been fixed
- You can now exit the pause menu using ESC key
- Resolution change issue where mouse would be restricted has been fixed.

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
Sadly there are a few known issues with this update which currently do not effect gameplay but we felt players should be made aware of. All previous saves sadly are no longer compatible with the current version and will be deleted upon updating.

- Dutch and German languages currently broken
- Additonal text currently not translated
- New notes in the notebook not being saved correctly when save/loading a game
- It currently rains inside buildings

We will be working very hard to get these issues fixed for you as soon as humanly possible.

Translations in the game are of course still not in a final state. These are community translations so there may be some issues. Also with the game being constantly expanding, some text may not have been translated yet.

Many Thanks
Tim

notes.title: Update 0.11.8 / 9[Live Now]
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

It is time for our 3rd update. We have a nice long list of changes for you this week ranging from graphical updates to gameplay additions. We are continuing to work hard on improving Better Late Than DEAD and we hope everyone will be happy with these changes.

The following changes have been made 

[h1]0.11.8 / 0.11.9[/h1]

- Height difference in First Person mode when crounching has been fixed
- Further improvements to textures to lessen blurring
- Meat cooking time fixed
- Sound FX volume slider fixed
- Animals no longer pass through doors
- Night-time slightly brighter than before
- You can no longer move when crouching with a broken bone
- Added additional option settings (Quality selection) and changes (crosses are now ticks)
- Increased area lit up by torch
- Used items can no longer be return to unused state through inventory bug
- Debug mode has been hidden better (New combination of keys to be pressed)
- Freezing effect from rain has been decreased
- You can now turn during combat and during other animations
- Torch has an increase smoke/flame trail effect
- Lighter has better effects when held
- You can now turn while swimming using the mouse
- You can now press esc to skip the intro
- Inventory space has been increased 

At the moment, the translations are still not in a final state. These are community translations so they may have some issues but we are going through these very shortly to fix any current errors. You can see our community translation project here - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/352950/discussions/6/]Community Translation Project[/url]

A big thank you to everyone who have joined us in our first week of EA. 

Many Thanks 
Tim

notes.title: Incoming Update - Blurriness & Inventory space
notes.content:
We are working hard on the game here and wanted to just share a little more information on what you can expect to see in the game by the end of this week.

First, players have been asking for a little more inventory space, so we’ve expanded the players inventory so they can carry much more items.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9Iy42W3.jpg[/img]

Secondly, we have reduced the blurriness of the game. We have some before and after screens below:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wnuTYN3.jpg[/img]

May be dificult to see the difference with the image above so feel free to check out bigger examples with the following link:

Version 0.11.7: http://i.imgur.com/coPyKd0.jpg

Version 0.11.8: http://i.imgur.com/83OooaV.jpg

We have a lot more additions to this update including how night is handled, increasing the torch radius and new graphic settings in the main menu that will change the quality of the game for players.

We hope to update the game very soon!

All the best,
Chris

It is time for another update. We have listened to the community and have started to make some changes to the game based on your suggestions. We are also working through the bugs which have been reported. 

The following changes have been made

[h1]0.11.7[/h1]

- Stones no longer instant kill animals
- Items now stay equppied when loading a save
- Duplicating item bug fixed
- You should now hear a sound when shakig trees
- You can now hold down left click or E to repeatedly shake a tree
- You can now turn around when using focus mode (Right click)
- Bears now have a bigger aggro range... No more sneaking up on them

Thanks again to everyone for joining us on our adventure on this rather strange island.

Many Thanks
Tim

notes.title: Patch 0.11.6 Now Live
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Firstly I would like to apologize for the delay on the latest build. This was due to unforseen errors when uploading and issues with steam DRM. Thankfully this is all fixed now. Of course you can expect the next build soon as well. With many more fixes and performance improvements.

We are constantly trying to improve the overall performance of the game and we will be working on this over the next couple of weeks. We have also taken on board many of your suggestions and are discussing how we can implement some of these into the game to make it more enjoyable for everyone.

A big thank you goes out to everyone who purchased the game day one and are sticking around for the adventure and growth of our game.


Many thanks
Tim

notes.title: Better Late Than DEAD... It Lives, Very Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/4/3261/3260397/profile/bltd1.png[/img]
We are fast approaching the Early Access launch of Better Late Than DEAD. We’d like to thank many of the community members for getting involved in the forums to offer support and suggestions. We have a long road ahead of us and we are at an early stage that allows us to really truly take on your feedback.

We also have a special piece of news. We were anticipating a release for MAC later on, but I can confirm that the MAC build will also be available tomorrow too. Of course, standard SteamPlay rules work here, if you buy it on PC you get the mac build and vice versa!

Better Late Than DEAD will launch at the following times:

PDT 3am
CDT 5am
BST 11am
CEST 12pm
EEST 1pm
AEST 8PM

And will cost around $6.99/£4.99 (Launch week discount will be added too!)
To whet your appetite, the game will begin with a comic story. We’ve made this live and you can view it below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B8kuiqf7T8A

We are also preparing a development roadmap to release ahead of the launch. I am working with the development team on this to factor in a decent timeframe for features but also to discuss regularly every player suggested comment so that we can implement these features into our development plan. I’m hoping to reveal how we are planning to select features, but suggestions will be prioritised and based on time required. We will try to be as open as possible with this procedure to keep everyone in the loop.

We will read and respond to as many posts in the forums as possible, so please continue to make suggestions as to how we can improve the game.

We will need to work on optimisation early on, this is high priority so we would like your assistance with this. When playing, if you experience performance issues, please get in touch with us via email at support@excalibur-publishing.com with your computer specs and details of the types of performance you are getting. We hope to of course, conquer this issue so your help is invaluable.

We have three months of planned content and improvements to make for Better Late Than DEAD. However, the list below is what we can achieve BEFORE we even consider working on player feedback. We’ve left room in our schedule to implement player suggestions so this will be the bare minimum we can develop.

[h1]Development roadmap[/h1]
- Sleep system
- Trap system
- Bow and arrow (combat and crafting)
- Aquatic animals, yes including sharks!
- New Items
- New crafting recipes
- More island details
- Keybinding
- Better server handling (saving, loading, optimization, etc)
- Dedicated server
- More characters visual on multiplayer
- Game story enhanced and evolved upon
- Bug fixes (This is early access after all!)
- Optimization (Very important, please help us with this!)

There's a lot of stuff here, and I'm pretty sure I missed a bunch, but myself and the team will be around to answer questions and to update you with progress. We are really looking forward to working with you all to make a fun game.

notes.title: Better Late Than Dead - Multiplayer Set Up At Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Over the next few months we will be expanding upon multiplayer for Better Late Than Dead. this includes increasing player count, improving performance and we are considering server options for players so game worlds can stay online 24/7. We will also be implementing the steam features required so that it will be easier to join friends games.

Right now, I wanted to let everyone know that we will have 4 player multiplayer at launch this Thursday. However, the method of multiplayer is a little more complicated and requires some knowledge of port forwarding to connect via IP address. We will be definitely expanding upon this as I know this is not the type of multiplayer many will be expecting, but in the first few weeks, this is the process that we will need to launch with...

See below for a small tutorial as to how players would connect in Better Late Than Dead.

[h1]Multiplayer Set Up Guide:[/h1]
First you will need to make sure your router is accepting traffic to your desired port (default 25000) and PC. Each Router is set up slightly differently for this but portforward.com has guides for most manufactured routers.  

http://portforward.com/english/routers/port_forwarding/

When on this site, you will need to locate your router manufacturer, then the router model. Both of these should be found on the router itself (if any ads pop up, click the x in the top right corner.) The site will then ask you to pick your game, sadly at the time of writing this guide, our game is not listed here, please click on Default Guide which is in the top explanation.

Read this guide through and follow it’s instructions to open the port number for the game.
Once the above has been completed, launch the game and click survive online and then create a server. You can now give yourself and your server a name. Leave the IP as it is and the port should be the same as what you previously set (default 25000). You can also set a password for your server to prevent others from joining. Once you are satisfied with the information click connect.

To connect to a server you will need to have the hosts IP address. They can find this out by typing IP Address into google and it should show your public ip address at the top. Type their IP address into the IP section and then their port number into the port section. Then enter the server password if this has been set. Then click on connect.

- We will also be implementing the steam features required so that it will be easier to join friends games.
- we will have 4 player multiplayer at launch this Thursday.
